query: Please implement a voice AI phone system that answers incoming calls and responds automatically. The system should have functionalities such as answering incoming calls, answering questions, sending text messages, sending links to products and services or forms, booking call-back times and setting up appointments, and sending a complete transcript of the call. Users should be able to interact with the system through voice commands, and the system should be able to understand and execute the corresponding actions. Configure the background color to powder blue, with components using medium blue.
